callsUsed.title: Entrata Demo Request
callsUsed.brief: Vince and Integration User spoke with Denise from Timberbank CC to discuss Entrata's potential to streamline property management across six properties currently using disparate systems. Denise is researching software options and will recommend one to the family-owned business, with key considerations being communication, remote access, task delegation, and online payment processing. A follow-up demo is scheduled to explore Entrata's capabilities in more detail, including potential ancillary revenue streams.

callsUsed.title: Entrata/Alberici - Platform Overview
callsUsed.brief: Denise, Alex, and Vincent (Phone Caller #2) discussed Entrata's software capabilities, including leasing, maintenance, payment processing, and reporting, with Denise expressing satisfaction and noting its user-friendliness and integration benefits. They also discussed pricing, implementation timelines, and data storage, and scheduled a follow-up meeting for Wednesday the ninth to discuss next steps after Denise reviews the other software options with Joe and Kelly. The goal is to have the system fully operational before taking over two additional properties in the next five to six months.
